source_title: Apple introduces the new 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6
source_excerpt:
M6: Blazing-Fast Performance and On-Device AI Capabilities
Up to 13x faster time to first token performance for LLM prompt processing compared to the 13-inch MacBook Pro with M1, and up to 1.3x faster than the 14-inch MacBook Pro with M5.
Up to 11.7x faster render performance with ray tracing in Blender compared to the 13-inch MacBook Pro with M1, and up to 1.3x faster than the 14-inch MacBook Pro with M5.
Up to 3.3x faster image-processing performance in Affinity compared to the 13-inch MacBook Pro with M1, and up to 1.2x faster than the 14-inch MacBook Pro with M5.
Up to 2.5x faster project build performance when compiling code in Xcode compared to the 13-inch MacBook Pro with M1, and up to 1.3x faster than the 14-inch MacBook Pro with M5.
Phenomenal battery life : In addition to the huge leap in performance, battery life gets up to 14 additional hours for Intel-based upgraders and up to four more hours for users coming from M1, delivering up to 24 hours overall, so users can get more done on a single charge. Users coming from Intel-based and M1 systems will also get 16GB of starting unified memory, an additional Thunderbolt port, and the space black finish with an anodization seal for fewer fingerprints.
A brilliant pro display : The stunning Liquid Retina XDR display delivers up to 1600 nits of peak HDR brightness and a 1,000,000:1 contrast ratio, bringing HDR photos and videos to life with deep blacks, brilliant highlights, and vibrant colors. And for users working in bright or challenging lighting conditions, a nano-texture display option dramatically reduces reflections and glare.
Powerful connectivity : Now with Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6, the 14-inch MacBook Pro delivers fast wireless performance and low latency, along with support for up to two external displays. Its versatile array of ports — including the HDMI, MagSafe 3, and three Thunderbolt 4 ports; an SDXC card slot; and a headphone jack — makes it easy to connect high-speed peripherals, transfer photos, or expand a workspace.
Advanced camera, mics, and speakers : A 12MP Center Stage camera with Desk View helps keep users perfectly framed on video calls, while a studio-quality three-mic array and amazing six-speaker sound system with Spatial Audio deliver an immersive audio experience.
Fast charging : MacBook Pro with M6 supports fast charging, reaching up to 50 percent charge in just 30 minutes when paired with a compatible higher-wattage USB-C power adapter, such as the 96W Power Adapter. 3
A laptop that’s built to last : With an enclosure made from 100 percent recycled aluminum, MacBook Pro is exceptionally durable and can stand up to everyday use for years to come.
Better together with iPhone : When used together with Continuity, iPhone and Mac are even more powerful — letting users move seamlessly across devices to share files and photos, hand off tasks, and even control their iPhone from their 14-inch MacBook Pro. 5 Users switching to Mac for the first time can use iPhone to conveniently and securely transfer settings, files, photos, passwords, and more.
14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 and the Environment
Customers can pre-order the new 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 starting tomorrow, October 28, on apple.com/store and in the Apple Store app in 35 countries and regions, including the U.S. It will begin arriving to customers, and in Apple Store locations and Apple Authorized Resellers, starting Friday, November 6.
The 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 starts at $1,999 (U.S.) and $1,899 (U.S.) with education savings . Additional technical specifications and configure-to-order options are available at apple.com/macbook-pro .
With Apple Upgrade , eligible customers in the U.S. can lease a new Mac with low monthly payments and easily upgrade at the end of their lease. 8 Lease the 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 with Apple Upgrade from $38.99 (U.S.) per month, excluding taxes and any trade-in credit, for 36 months.^
With Apple Trade In, customers can trade in their current computer and get credit toward a new Mac. Customers can visit apple.com/shop/trade-in to see what their device is worth. With year-round education pricing — available to current and newly accepted college students and educators — customers can save on MacBook Pro, along with a wide range of products and services through the Apple Store online and in stores. Visit the Apple Education Store for details. Customers in the U.S. who shop at Apple using Apple Card 9 can pay monthly at 0 percent APR when they choose to check out with Apple Card Monthly Installments, 10 and they’ll get 3 percent Daily Cash back — all up front. More information — including details on eligibility, exclusions, and Apple Card terms — is available at apple.com/apple-card/monthly-installments .
AppleCare delivers exceptional service and support, with flexible options for Apple users. Customers can choose AppleCare+ to cover their new Mac or, in available markets, AppleCare One to protect multiple products in one simple plan. Both plans include coverage for accidents like drops and spills, theft and loss protection on eligible products, battery replacement service, and priority support from Apple Experts. In the U.S., customers can also choose AppleCare One Family, which extends that same coverage to every eligible device across an Apple Family Sharing group for one fixed monthly price. For more information, visit apple.com/applecare .
Every customer who buys directly from Apple gets access to Personal Setup. In these guided one-on-one online sessions, a Specialist can walk them through setup or focus on features that will help them make the most of their new device. Customers can also learn more about getting started and going further with their new device with a Today at Apple session at their nearest Apple Store.
Text of this article October 27, 2026 PRESS RELEASE Apple introduces :br(s):the new 14‑inch :br(s):MacBook Pro with M6 Supercharged by M6, the 14-inch MacBook Pro features incredible performance and next-level AI capabilities, enhanced connectivity, and up to 24 hours of battery life, delivering even more value CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA Apple today announced the new 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 , delivering even more performance, powerful on-device AI capabilities, and faster connectivity for college students, business users, creators, and more. M6 features an advanced 12-core CPU with the world’s fastest CPU core, so everything from productivity tasks to more demanding pro workflows feels incredibly fast and responsive. 1 The 12-core GPU delivers up to 30 percent faster graphics and up to 25 percent faster AI workloads when compared to M5, making the 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 a compelling value for users who need serious power. 2 For those upgrading from M1, the performance gains are even more significant, with up to 11x faster graphics and up to 13x faster AI performance. 3 With additional Neural Accelerators in the GPU and a Dual 16-core Neural Engine, M6 turns MacBook Pro into an even more powerful platform for AI — from taking advantage of Siri AI and Apple Intelligence features across apps and macOS to running LLMs locally, all while preserving user privacy. 4 In addition, the 14-inch MacBook Pro features Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6, while superfast storage makes working with large files, exporting projects, and running demanding AI workflows fly. And with phenomenal battery life of up to 24 hours, it delivers the same remarkable performance whether plugged in or on battery, so users can work, create, and pursue their passions from anywhere. 3 It also offers the advanced features users love, including the stunning Liquid Retina XDR display with a nano-texture option, a 12MP Center Stage camera, an immersive six-speaker sound system, and a wide array of ports. Together with macOS 27, the new 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 is a major upgrade for existing Mac users and those coming to Mac for the first time. Available in space black and silver, it can be pre-ordered beginning tomorrow, October 28, with availability starting Friday, November 6. “The 14-inch MacBook Pro is the pro laptop of choice for a wide range of users — from college students, to business professionals across every industry, to multidisciplinary creators doing it all on one device,” said Shelly Goldberg, Apple’s vice president of Hardware Engineering. “With the powerful M6 chip, we’re taking performance to the next level, with a boost in CPU speed and graphics and even more powerful capabilities for on-device AI. With its amazing battery life, remarkable Liquid Retina XDR display, and even faster connectivity, the new 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 delivers a fantastic combination of performance, capability, and value.” M6: Blazing-Fast Performance and On-Device AI Capabilities M6 brings even more performance and next-level AI capabilities to the 14-inch MacBook Pro. Featuring a powerful 12-core CPU, a 12-core GPU with Neural Accelerators in each core, Dual 16-core Neural Engine, and faster unified memory, MacBook Pro with M6 is faster and more responsive. The 12-core CPU, with two more cores than before, brings blazing-fast single- and multithreaded performance, so users can fly through everything from multitasking across apps to compiling code to handling complex creative workflows. The 12-core GPU, also with two additional cores, delivers up to 30 percent faster graphics performance when compared to M5. 2 Everything from 3D modeling to photo editing and gaming feels incredibly fast, enhanced by a third-generation ray-tracing engine and Dynamic Caching to optimize on-chip memory. It also brings up to 25 percent faster performance for on-device AI workloads, like LLM prompt processing, compared to M5. 3 The Dual 16-core Neural Engine delivers up to 1.9x faster performance than M5 and works with the advanced GPU to dramatically accelerate AI workloads like image generation, Super Resolution, and AI upscaling. 2 The Neural Engine also powers Apple Intelligence, enabling advanced and energy-efficient on-device AI processing. The 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 does all this with industry-leading performance per watt and up to 24 hours of battery life, the longest ever in a Mac. With 16GB of unified memory standard, configurable up to 32GB, and higher memory bandwidth up to 170GB/s, MacBook Pro makes multitasking and working with demanding apps and large projects even faster. The 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 enables : 3 Up to 13x faster time to first token performance for LLM prompt processing compared to the 13-inch MacBook Pro with M1, and up to 1.3x faster than the 14-inch MacBook Pro with M5. Up to 11.7x faster render performance with ray tracing in Blender compared to the 13-inch MacBook Pro with M1, and up to 1.3x faster than the 14-inch MacBook Pro with M5. Up to 3.3x faster image-processing performance in Affinity compared to the 13-inch MacBook Pro with M1, and up to 1.2x faster than the 14-inch MacBook Pro with M5. Up to 2.5x faster project build performance when compiling code in Xcode compared to the 13-inch MacBook Pro with M1, and up to 1.3x faster than the 14-inch MacBook Pro with M5. A Huge Upgrade with Even More Value There’s never been a better time for customers to upgrade from a previous-generation MacBook Pro with Apple silicon or an Intel-based Mac. The 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 delivers remarkable value thanks to major performance improvements and powerful AI capabilities. The new 14-inch MacBook Pro also features all of the compelling capabilities that have made it so popular, including: Phenomenal battery life : In addition to the huge leap in performance, battery life gets up to 14 additional hours for Intel-based upgraders and up to four more hours for users coming from M1, delivering up to 24 hours overall, so users can get more done on a single charge. Siri AI can draw on personal context to help users find what they need in the moment across messages, emails, photos, and more; answer questions about virtually any topic; and get things done across apps — all with groundbreaking privacy protections. Siri AI is integrated into Spotlight and systemwide context menus, and users can ask Siri about what’s on their display with Visual Intelligence using a dedicated keyboard shortcut. Users can also write and edit with Siri almost anywhere they type. Additionally, Apple Intelligence makes apps smarter and more useful. In Safari, it powers new tools that automatically organize a user’s tabs into topics; notify them of website changes, like product restocks or price drops; and enable the creation of custom extensions based on a description. Users can also easily create an automation in Shortcuts by simply describing it, or tap into intelligent photo editing tools in the Photos app. The new 14-inch MacBook Pro gets even more responsive, reliable, and delightful with refinements to design, performance, search, and more. Updates to Liquid Glass deliver an even more focused and approachable experience. A new slider in Settings gives users the option to personalize Liquid Glass, adjusting it anywhere from ultraclear to fully tinted to match their preference, and app icons are sharper and more defined. 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 and the Environment The new 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 was built with the environment in mind and drives progress toward Apple’s ambitious plan to be carbon neutral across its entire footprint by 2030. It is made with 45 percent recycled content overall, 6 including 100 percent recycled aluminum in the enclosure, 100 percent recycled cobalt in the battery, and, in a first for Apple, 100 percent recycled tantalum in multiple capacitors. It is manufactured with 60 percent renewable electricity, such as wind and solar, across the supply chain. The 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 is designed to be durable and repairable, and meets Apple’s high standards for energy efficiency and safe chemistry. As with all Apple products, its paper packaging is 100 percent fiber-based 7 and designed to be recycled. ## सारांश
एप्पल ने 14‑इंच मैकबुक प्रो के साथ नया M6 प्रोसेसर लॉन्च किया। यह लैपटॉप क्रिएटर्स, छात्रों और प्रोफेशनल्स को लक्षित करता है, जिसमें ग्राफिक्स में 30 % तक तेज़ी, AI टोकन जेनरेशन में 13 × तेज़ी और बैटरी लाइफ़ 24 घंटे तक का वादा किया गया है।

## मुख्य तकनीकी विवरण
- **M6 चिप** – 12‑कोर CPU, 12‑कोर GPU (न्यूरल एक्सेलेरेटर सहित), ड्यूल 16‑कोर न्यूरल इंजन
- **मेमोरी** – 16 GB यूनिफाइड मेमोरी (कस्टमाइज़ कर 32 GB तक), 170 GB/s बैंडविड्थ
- **डिस्प्ले** – 14‑इंच लिक्विड रेटिना XDR, 1600 निट्स पीक HDR, नैनो‑टेक्सचर विकल्प
- **कनेक्टिविटी** – Wi‑Fi 7, ब्लूटूथ 6, HDMI, MagSafe 3, तीन थंडरबोल्ट 4 पोर्ट, SDXC स्लॉट, हेडफ़ोन जैक
- **कैमरा और ऑडियो** – 12 MP सेंटर स्टेज कैमरा (डेस्क व्यू), तीन‑माइक एरे, स्पेशियल ऑडियो के साथ छह‑स्पीकर सिस्टम
- **बैटरी** – एक चार्ज पर 24 घंटे तक; 96 W एडाप्टर से 30 मिनट में 50 % तेज़ चार्ज
- **पर्यावरण** – 100 % रीसाइकल्ड एल्यूमिनियम बॉडी, कुल 45 % रीसाइकल्ड सामग्री

## प्रदर्शन के दावे (एप्पल द्वारा)
- **AI वर्कलोड**: 13‑इंच M1 मॉडल की तुलना में LLM प्रॉम्प्ट के लिए टाइम‑टू‑फ़र्स्ट‑टोकन में 13 × तेज़; 14‑इंच M5 से 1.3 × तेज़।
- **रे‑ट्रेसिंग रेंडर**: ब्लेंडर में 13‑इंच M1 से 11.7 × तेज़; M5 से 1.3 × तेज़।
- **इमेज प्रोसेसिंग**: Affinity में 13‑इंच M1 से 3.3 × तेज़; M5 से 1.2 × तेज़।
- **Xcode बिल्ड**: 13‑इंच M1 से 2.5 × तेज़ कंपाइल; M5 से 1.3 × तेज़।

> **ध्यान दें:** ये सभी आँकड़े एप्पल के अपने बेंचमार्क पर आधारित हैं और स्वतंत्र रूप से सत्यापित नहीं किए गए हैं।

## कीमत, उपलब्धता और खरीद विकल्प
- **लॉन्च तिथि** – प्री‑ऑर्डर 28 अक्टूबर 2026 से शुरू; डिलीवरी 6 नवंबर 2026 से।
- **कीमत** – बेस मॉडल $1,999 USD; शिक्षा छूट के साथ $1,899 USD।
- **वित्तीय विकल्प** – Apple Upgrade लीज़ $38.99 /माह (अमेरिका) 36 महीने के लिए; Apple Card Monthly Installments पर 0 % APR।
- **ट्रेड‑इन** – मौजूदा मैक को Apple Trade‑In के ज़रिए क्रेडिट में बदल सकते हैं।

## व्यावहारिक प्रभाव
- **क्रिएटर्स के लिए**: तेज़ GPU और AI एक्सेलेरेशन से 3‑डी रेंडर और वीडियो प्रोसेसिंग में समय घटेगा।
- **डेवलपर्स के लिए**: तेज़ Xcode बिल्ड और लंबी बैटरी लाइफ़ ऑन‑द‑गो कोडिंग को आसान बनाती है।
- **छात्रों के लिए**: शिक्षा कीमत और 24‑घंटे बैटरी पुराने Intel या M1 मैक को बदलने के लिए आकर्षक विकल्प बनाती है।
- **सत्यापन**: एप्पल की आधिकारिक न्यूज़रूम पेज (apple.com/newsroom) और प्रोडक्ट पेज (apple.com/macbook-pro) पर स्पेसिफिकेशन की जाँच करें।

## घोषणा की पुष्टि कैसे करें
1. प्रेस रिलीज़ के लिंक पर जाएँ (apple.com/newsroom)।
2. प्रोडक्ट पेज में “Tech Specs” सेक्शन देखें।
3. एप्पल द्वारा जारी PDF फ़ाइल डाउनलोड करके लॉन्च डेट और कीमत की तुलना करें।
4. डिवाइस के शिप होने के बाद विश्वसनीय टेक साइट्स (The Verge, Ars Technica) के रिव्यू पढ़ें।

en_body:
## Summary
Apple announced the 14‑inch MacBook Pro equipped with the next‑generation M6 processor. The device targets creators, students and professionals, promising up to 30 % faster graphics, up to 13 × quicker AI token generation and up to 24 hours of battery life.

## Key Specifications
- **M6 chip** – 12‑core CPU, 12‑core GPU with Neural Accelerators, dual 16‑core Neural Engine
- **Memory** – 16 GB unified memory standard (configurable to 32 GB) with 170 GB/s bandwidth
- **Display** – 14‑inch Liquid Retina XDR, 1600 nits peak HDR, optional nano‑texture screen
- **Connectivity** – Wi‑Fi 7, Bluetooth 6, HDMI, MagSafe 3, three Thunderbolt 4 ports, SDXC slot, headphone jack
- **Camera & Audio** – 12 MP Center Stage camera with Desk View, three‑mic array, six‑speaker system with Spatial Audio
- **Battery** – Up to 24 hours on a single charge; fast‑charge to 50 % in 30 minutes with a 96 W adapter
- **Environmental** – Enclosure made from 100 % recycled aluminum; 45 % recycled content overall

## Performance Claims (Apple‑provided)
- **AI workloads**: up to 13 × faster time‑to‑first‑token for LLM prompts vs. 13‑inch M1 model; 1.3 × faster than the 14‑inch M5.
- **Ray‑traced rendering**: up to 11.7 × faster in Blender vs. 13‑inch M1; 1.3 × faster than M5.
- **Image processing**: up to 3.3 × faster in Affinity vs. 13‑inch M1; 1.2 × faster than M5.
- **Xcode builds**: up to 2.5 × faster compile times vs. 13‑inch M1; 1.3 × faster than M5.

> **Note:** All performance figures are from Apple‑conducted benchmarks and have not been independently verified.

## Pricing, Availability & Purchase Options
- **Launch dates** – Pre‑orders start 28 Oct 2026; shipments begin 6 Nov 2026.
- **Price** – $1,999 USD (base model); education discount brings it to $1,899 USD.
- **Financing** – Apple Upgrade lease from $38.99 /mo (U.S.) for 36 months; Apple Card Monthly Installments at 0 % APR.
- **Trade‑in** – Existing Macs can be exchanged for credit via Apple’s Trade‑In program.

## Practical Implications
- **For creators**: Faster GPU and AI acceleration mean shorter render times in 3‑D and video workflows.
- **For developers**: Faster Xcode builds and longer battery life improve on‑the‑go coding sessions.
- **For students**: The education price and longer battery life make the laptop a viable replacement for older Intel or M1 Macs.
- **Verification**: Users can confirm the announcement on Apple’s official newsroom page (apple.com/newsroom) and check the product page (apple.com/macbook-pro) for the latest specifications.

## How to Verify the Announcement
1. Visit the Apple Newsroom URL cited in the press release.
2. Compare the listed specs with the product page under “Tech Specs”.
3. Look for the Apple‑issued PDF of the press release, which includes the exact launch dates and pricing.
4. Check independent tech sites (e.g., The Verge, Ars Technica) for early hands‑on impressions once the device ships.
